purpose: Compare first-delivery page quality across no coach, coach with autonomous method reads, and coach with host-supplied complete selected-method materials

authorization.user_scope: User authorized a local three-arm experiment; no online deployment or production-workspace modification
authorization.limit_origin: Internal allocation fixed before the first freeze or call; not a user-specified monetary limit
authorization.limit_reason: Twelve planned pages and longer complete-material inputs in C, while retaining the inherited relay worst-case per-request reservations; no expansion after freeze
authorization.pricing: Reuse EX13 peak-price estimate and conservative reservation. Preserve missing-usage and failed-stream reservations; these are not an actual provider bill

previous_activity.relationship: Separate completed diagnostic activity, retained in cross-activity total; not charged again against this new 20 CNY allowance

model.limits: Same main-author request settings and production per-request limits across all arms
model.served_model: Record returned model on every call; alias alone does not prove a fixed backend version

presentation_plan.scope: B and C independently call the same coach prompt and configuration. A makes no coach call

limits.retry_policy: No pilot, no replacement runs, no retry of failed samples. Ordinary generation/intervention failure and per-run32-call exhaustion remain in the comparison and subsequent arms proceed. A local Budget subclass refuses the current run after32 calls without modifying global stopped; global call ceiling remains384. Monetary exhaustion, provider stream failure, missing usage or timeout stop the batch; retain remaining runs as unstarted

A.label: No coach
A.behavior: No presentation coach call or handoff. Author still has the same catalog, author prompt and read_method tool and may independently read methods

B.label: Coach, autonomous reads
B.behavior: Coach supplies purpose, learning goal, reading path and selected methods. Main author chooses which method materials to read through existing tools

C.label: Coach, complete selected materials supplied
C.behavior: Same coach independently selects methods; host supplies all files of those selected methods to the subsequent author request. Do not supply the entire library. Actual supplied text is separate evidence from tool reads

comparison.estimand: End-to-end strategy difference in first-delivery page quality. B and C have independent coach plans, so this does not strictly isolate forced reading under one identical plan
comparison.shared: Identical heldout input, main author model/prompt/tools/limits, method catalog and assets, fresh per-run history, and frozen Reader
comparison.balanced_order: Four consecutive three-arm blocks, each containing A/B/C; all arms have equal global mean order position
comparison.failure_inclusion: Every scheduled sample is reported as delivered, failed/incomplete, or unstarted. C material coverage is an intervention check, never an eligibility gate or page-quality proxy

catalog.source: ../common-source/skills/presentation/methods/catalog.json; revision6 and11 method versions including chart-reveal@3; source-freeze.json records byte identity with prior verified catalog
catalog.candidate_status: Local experiment only; online and formally adopted catalog remain unchanged
catalog.selection: No method IDs or method_refs seeded in heldout author prompts. Coach may choose no method

isolation.source: ../source-freeze.json and ../logs/three-arm-verification.json; all three runtime/server artifacts freshly compiled, binaries pairwise different,1039 nonvariant files byte-identical per arm. Only source variation is presentation_trial.rs ARM=A/B/C.
isolation.author_input: Byte-identical copies of the two previously unused heldout tasks; no pilot outputs, evaluator notes or teacher-example hints
isolation.task_exposure: Only root and experiment custodian may inspect author tasks and oracle before generation; implementation agents do not receive them
isolation.history: Fresh native memory, history and temp directory per run; no base-version or prior-conversation import
isolation.coach: Separate actual user text, author proposal, read-source evidence, prior guidance and compact catalog. B/C each produce their own actual plan; no caching or replay across runs
isolation.reader: render-source/manifest.json; exact existing seven-file Reader freeze reused for A/B/C
isolation.teaching_review: Same observing fixture; no active Tutor review loop

outcomes.primary: First successful delivery in the initial user turn, allowing ordinary self-preview and patch. Review page correctness and communicative usefulness against task and independent oracle
outcomes.linkage: Separate selected methods, autonomous tool reads, host-forced actual material text, complete-file coverage, declared method_refs and visible application. None is a substitute for page quality
outcomes.coach_record: Extract purpose=tutor_presentation_plan request and matching response. Require actual presentation_coach.v1 definition in later ordered messages, not just asset declaration
outcomes.forced_supply_record: Each selected catalog file is a resident-agent.presentation.method-source.{method_id}.{revision}.{file}@method-source.v1 InstructionModule. Actual ordered system sampling_guidance.v1 definition contains presentation_method_source.v1 plus JSON {method_id,revision,file,characters,text}. Record exact character coverage and request order separately from tool reads. observations.supplied_files confirms successful runtime sampling per asset but has no request ordinal; a manifest alone never counts. Preserve response errors, absent receipts and partial intervention without excluding quality samples
outcomes.also_archive: First write and first delivery, public native/provider I/O, actual coach input/output, all method-read/forced-supply evidence, failures/incomplete outcomes, usage, conservative cost and unstarted IDs
outcomes.evaluation: Read full rendered page and exercise actual UI. Mechanism topic needs shared-node identity and path accumulation; derivation topic needs complete connected derivation and degenerate-case reasoning. Do not impose universal short-video or first-screen-chart criteria
outcomes.decision: Small directional end-to-end comparison; no learner-outcome claim. Retain all failures, coverage gaps and differences in coach plans

validation.status: Frozen: runtime4, server2 and8 runner/evidence checks passed; three binaries verified. Provider calls during preparation:0.
